desc: 蜜桃果冻配水光晶透四色，空刻度水波板承载真空金属头唇护叙事
leaf: 金属头水润肽类有色唇部精华
name: 果冻水光肽类唇部精华笔款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代晶透管身与金属按摩头。
用一支斜置晶管的三枚空白引线，讲清真空按压与曲面金属头机制。
用同一双唇左哑右亮的半侧对照，一秒展示上唇前后的水光丰盈差。
用三条不同肤色小臂上叠放的果冻色柱，展示全色号谱系在肤上的水光表现。
用金属按摩头贴着下唇滑过的瞬间，把上妆写成一次清凉护理。
用一列五枚叠放果冻色膏配三行空闪光利益栏，把多效卖点排成清单版式。
收口促单，用三格水光唇加一格晶透质地的四宫格把色号位留白待填。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless milk-apricot field #FBF4EE for packshot and board frames, one aqua-gel ripple wash #EAF2F4 reserved for texture panels, soft skin-tone blur inside lip crop tiles, pale rose gradient frame for the before-after diptych, no dark stages
style.direction: dewy jelly lip-serum pen commerce with rose-metal hardware accents
style.iconSystem: tiny four-point sparkle glyphs in rose #D97A8E before blank caption rails, thin curved leader arrows, no SPF marks, no clinical icons, no stars
style.lightingSystem: wet-look beauty light near 6000K, broad soft key with crisp specular chips on gel ridges and glossy lips, one cool glint travelling the rose-metal applicator, shadowless boards, never matte flatlight
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dewy jelly lip-serum pen ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of peach jelly #F2A08A, rose dew #D97A8E, aqua crystal white #EAF2F4 and milk apricot base #FBF4EE; wet-look beauty light near 6000K with crisp specular chips on gel ridges and glossy lips, one cool glint travelling the rose-metal tip and shadowless boards; glossy gel swirls, rose-gold mirror metal, frosted tube bodies, smooth skin crops and clear water-wave panels only, no marble, no powder textures, no dark stages; one soft rounded sans in plum kept as empty placeholder rails and sparkle rows; lip crops anonymous from the nose down; no color palette changes, no readable shade numbers, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable shade numbers or claims
no identity in any face crop
style.presentationRules: the pen always shows its frosted body with a blank label band and the sculpted rose-metal tip, lip crops are anonymous from the nose down with real texture kept, gel swipes stack with visible ripple rims, shade numbers never appear
style.surfaceSystem: glossy gel swirls with visible ripple edges, rose-gold mirror metal tip, frosted tube body, smooth skin crops with real lip texture, clear water-wave relief panels, no marble, no powder textures
style.typography: one soft rounded sans in plum ink with at most one rose highlight, every headline, shade number, sparkle row and caption slot kept as an empty placeholder
